name: Constrained-Text-Generation-Studio
headline: Humanizer Claude Skill: AI Text to Human Writing
short_description: The Humanizer skill for Claude transforms AI-generated text into natural, human-like writing. It removes robotic patterns, improves flow, and adds conversational nuance to content. Used by marketers, writers, and content teams who need AI-assisted drafts that sound authentic and engaging.
author: blader

sections.overview:
Humanizer is a skill for Claude Code and OpenCode that detects and removes signs of AI-generated writing, making text sound more natural and human. It analyzes 25 patterns commonly found in AI output and rewrites content to improve flow and authenticity. The skill supports voice calibration, allowing you to provide samples of your own writing so it can match your personal style and sentence rhythm. This helps marketers, content teams, and writers transform AI-assisted drafts into engaging, authentic-sounding content without generic robotic patterns.
Transform Claude-generated marketing copy into conversational, engaging content
Remove AI detection patterns from blog posts and articles written by Claude
Humanize automated email responses for customer communication
Refine AI-generated social media posts to sound more authentic
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install blader/humanizer`
`git clone https://github.com/blader/humanizer`
sections.usage:
```
Humanize the following AI-generated text to make it sound natural and conversational while preserving its original meaning: [TEXT_TO_HUMANIZE]. Focus on: 1) Replacing robotic phrasing with everyday language, 2) Varying sentence length for better flow, 3) Adding subtle conversational elements like contractions or informal transitions, and 4) Ensuring the tone matches [DESIRED_TONE: e.g., friendly, professional, or casual]. Avoid making it sound overly salesy unless specified.
```
Copy

```
Original AI-generated text: 'It is recommended that you implement a comprehensive customer retention strategy to enhance satisfaction levels and drive long-term revenue growth.'

Humanized version:

Hey there! If you’re looking to keep your customers happy and coming back for more, I’d suggest putting together a solid retention plan. Think of it like building a relationship—you wouldn’t want to lose someone you’ve put so much effort into, right? A little strategy here can go a long way in boosting satisfaction and, ultimately, your bottom line. What’s worked for you so far, or where do you feel you could use a hand?
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
